evaluation_goal: Verify that source content is transformed into a usable, traceable knowledge base.

future_metrics: duplicate rate; stale-source detection; ingestion failure rate; content coverage

evaluation_goal: Measure whether relevant chunks are retrieved for a user query.
current_metrics: Top-K retrieval results; retrieval relevance; retrieval latency
future_metrics: Recall@K; Precision@K; MRR; nDCG; no-answer retrieval accuracy
cost_metrics: embedding tokens; embedding cost; vector-search cost

evaluation_goal: Compare baseline semantic retrieval with improved / reranked retrieval.

future_metrics: Precision@K; MRR; nDCG; reranker contribution; retrieval cost / quality trade-off
cost_metrics: embedding cost; reranking cost; retrieval cost per successful query
